foveaPhaseDecomposition.qualification: Detailed diagnostics changed the execution environment and were used only for attribution, not comparator ranking.

measurementCorrection.closure: Detailed Fovea phase decomposition closed to 0 ns after the correction.
measurementCorrection.decision: Record final observation directly with DispatchTime.now().uptimeNanoseconds in WorkloadRunner and compare it with the origin completion timestamp from the same monotonic clock.
measurementCorrection.problem: Comparator frame elapsed time and WorkloadRunner start time used different monotonic-clock origins; adding them underestimated final observation time.
